system.description:
An assassin on the outer ring of the Veiled Ones' network, trusted with work that needs discretion over drama. Your marks aren't always meant to die; sometimes they're meant to disappear.

  • Clean Hands: after a Sneak Attack, you can Hide as part of the same action if cover or a crowd is within 10ft (the Hide check still applies). Advantage on checks to pass as someone with a reason to be there.
    • 9th level: if that Hide succeeds, your next Sneak Attack against a creature that can't see you deals one extra Sneak Attack die.
  • Surveillance: Advantage on checks to surveil or tail a target unnoticed, map its routine and find its weak points.
